jobs.title: Keenon T8 — Narrow-Aisle Table Delivery & Bussing (55 cm)
jobs.why: Key narrow-aisle benchmark: compact ~34 kg chassis clears 55 cm passages, shuttling 3 trays (20 kg) between counter and tight café tables.
jobs.limits: 20 kg max total payload across 3 open trays; staff or guests lift cups/plates manually, and floor steps >15 mm block travel.

jobs.title: Pudu KettyBot Pro — Entrance Greeter, Ad-Screen & Guest Escort
jobs.why: Welcomes visitors at the entrance, displays live promotions on its front ad screen, and escorts guests through 55 cm aisles.
jobs.limits: Compact 55 cm frame handles greeting, escorting, and light sampling only — cannot process payments or open doors.

jobs.title: Bear Robotics Servi — Main-Lane Order Runner & Dish Busser
jobs.why: 44.5 × 43 cm footprint with 2 trays + dedicated dirty-dish bussing tub handles counter-to-pass runs up to 30 kg.
jobs.limits: Downgraded to Partial: requires ~65 cm minimum aisle clearance, restricting access between tightly spaced ~58 cm café tables.

jobs.title: Pudu BellaBot / Pro — 4-Tray Restaurant Delivery Runner
jobs.why: High-capacity 4-tray (40 kg) waiter bot is an industry leader for spacious dining rooms, but its chassis is too wide here.
jobs.limits: Marked Not Suitable: requires ~70 cm minimum aisle width, exceeding this café's narrow ~58 cm table clearances (use Keenon T8 at 55 cm).
